Part of the Unified Communication line of products, the CAM-210-NDI-PTZ offers a premium video conferencing experience. HD 1080p video ensures users appear crystal clear in their meetings. A high-quality pan and tilt motor provides a smooth experience without excess noise or judder. Equipped with four outputs, the CAM-210-NDI-PTZ can output video via its USB 3.0 port, HDMI port, network connection, or NDI®. NDI support enables ultra-low latency video integration with professional AV systems, making it ideal for broadcasting, streaming, and production environments. 3rd-party control is a breeze by utilizing the industry-standard VISCA protocol. An integrated web interface and free PC software provide advanced configuration options.

Advanced configuration can be made through the integrated web interface or the software available in the WyreStorm management suite. Adjust settings such as resolution, framerate, brightness, contrast and much more.

NDI allows seamless integration with compatible NVRs, streaming platforms, and production environments, offering unparalleled flexibility for professional AV setups.
